posts.headline: Tyrique14 is back with the crown, but the Thicks have never actually been dominant — they're a .500 team wearing a championship ring.
posts.detail: One title in two seasons sounds nice until you remember the career record is a pedestrian 14-14 with an average finish of 5.5. Draft night better fix that, because the league is coming for #FreeMaxx Champions and everybody knows it.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra is the best team that's never won it all — and that's the most Dallas Cowboys thing in this entire league.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and an average finish of 1.5 is video-game stuff, but zero titles means One Nut Barner keeps choking at the finish line. All that pedigree means nothing if adambarner111 can't finally close it out this year.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is the literal worst pedigree in the league and nobody should expect a turnaround.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last average finish of 12 isn't a slump, it's an identity. Chauncey's got nowhere to go but up, but this league has heard that before.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World won a title but has been quietly mediocre ever since, and Megamind knows it.
posts.detail: One ring can't hide a 13-15 career record and an average finish of 5.5 — that's a champion coasting on fumes. Big Head better show up with more than nostalgia this draft.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh enters the season with the second-worst pedigree in the league and zero reason for optimism.
posts.detail: A 5-9 record and an average finish of 11 says it all — the Prince of Persia has been ruling over nothing. Time to see if year two looks any different, though history says don't hold your breath.
